successCriteria.description: src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports LeaveRequestStatus enum with exactly five members: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED

src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports LeaveType interface with all specified fields: id (string), code (string), name (string), description (string), isPaid (boolean), requiresDocumentation (boolean), isActive (boolean), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date)

src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports LeavePolicy interface with all specified fields: id, policyName, leaveTypeId, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxCarryoverDays, minRequestDays, maxConsecutiveDays, requiresDocumentation, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt

src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports LeaveRequest interface with all specified fields including status typed as LeaveRequestStatus, and all approval/rejection/cancellation tracking fields (approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason)
src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports CreateLeaveRequestDto and UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto types
src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts exports ILeaveRepository interface extending IBaseRepository<LeaveRequest> with at minimum the five base methods (findById, findAll, create, update, delete)
src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts exports KnexLeaveRepository class extending BaseKnexRepository<LeaveRequest>, accepting Knex instance via constructor, using table name 'leave_requests'
KnexLeaveRepository uses NotFoundError from src/shared/error.types.ts when findById returns null and the caller needs a guaranteed entity (or when update targets a non-existent row)

tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts contains Jest unit tests mocking the Knex instance and covering all repository methods: findById (found and not-found), findAll, create, update (success and not-found), delete

constraints: KnexLeaveRepository must extend BaseKnexRepository<LeaveRequest> from src/shared/base.repository.ts — no other base class
All database access in KnexLeaveRepository must go through the Knex query builder; no raw SQL or other ORM

LeavePolicy interface must use the field names from the task spec: maxCarryoverDays, minRequestDays, requiresDocumentation (not the reconciled architecture's maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval)

LeaveRequest interface must include all six cancellation/approval/rejection tracking fields: approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason
Repository must use NotFoundError from src/shared/error.types.ts for missing-entity cases; no ad-hoc error classes
Tests must mock Knex instance — no real database connection in unit tests
outOfScope: State-transition validation logic (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, etc.) — belongs to service layer in Phase 3
findOverlapping method on the repository — needed for BR-002 overlap detection but not specified in this phase's task; belongs to service-layer orchestration phase
Other modules (employee, policy, balance, notification, audit) — not part of this phase

ambiguities.description: CreateLeaveRequestDto and UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto are specified by name only — no fields are declared. The code-agent must infer fields from the LeaveRequest interface (e.g., CreateLeaveRequestDto likely omits id, status, and audit tracking fields; UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto likely contains status and optional reason fields).
options: Infer UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto as { status: LeaveRequestStatus; reason?: string }

ambiguities.description: The reconciled architecture specifies ILeaveRequestRepository.findOverlapping(employeeId, startDate, endDate, excludeId?) for BR-002 overlap detection, but the task spec does not mention this method. It is unclear whether findOverlapping should be added to ILeaveRepository in this phase or deferred.
options: Defer findOverlapping to the service phase (task-spec-driven)

ambiguities.description: BaseKnexRepository.update() does not throw NotFoundError when the row doesn't exist — it returns whatever PostgreSQL returns (possibly undefined). The success criteria expect NotFoundError on missing entities. Should KnexLeaveRepository override update() to add a not-found check, or is the base behavior acceptable for this phase?
options: Override update() in KnexLeaveRepository to throw NotFoundError when no row is returned
Keep base class behavior as-is; NotFoundError handling belongs in the service layer
